text:
oncall-bot: Pager: SEV2 - embedder latency spike in us-west-2. Page ID 48922. Routing errors and elevated 5xx rates, paging #oncall-sre.

maria: I'm on it, connecting to traces and hotfixing routing.

sam: Handoff in ~7m for scheduled rotation. If no update, @carla will take over.

maria: quick findings - kvcache.evictions up, mem pressure on embedder nodes. Spawning temporary reroute: `curl -X POST "http://router.internal/reroute?target=us-east"`

ops-sre: seeing the same from infra: `kvcache.evictions: 11.8k/m` and `oom_kill_count: 2` on embedder-3.

raj: Customer impact estimate: ~3.4% error rate over 12m window, no SLA breaches yet but some PLG customers saw degraded UX. Posting to status page now.

carla: Taking over. Maria, summarise what you changed so I can pick up monitoring and comms.

maria: Done: rerouted ~30% of traffic to us-east to reduce tail; bumped KV TTL to 10m; rolled back feature flip `prefix_cache=false` (commit 3b7f9). Saved KV snapshot: `/var/tmp/kvdump-2511002468.tar.gz`.

carla: Good. I'll keep the reroute for 30m and watch latency/evictions. Opening a short live doc in #incidents-retros for the post-incident writeup.

sam: Suggest we schedule a postmortem with SRE, runtime, and product tomorrow. Proposed: 15:00 PT.

luis: Action items I think we need: 1) RCA on why TTL/config flip increased evictions - owner @raj - estimate 2d; 2) formal failover runbook and playbook (include automated reroute) - owner @carla - estimate 3d; 3) add canary gating for config flips - owner @maria - estimate 1.5d; 4) status page auto-posting for degraded embedder - owner @sam - estimate 0.5d.

carla: Severity/priority notes: impact below 5% and no committed SLA breach => classify as SEV2. Recommend items 1 and 2 be prioritized this sprint, item 3 as medium priority, item 4 quick win. Tie playbook into Q2 reliability OKR.

emma: Product signoff: OK to slot the playbook (item 2) and RCA (item 1) into next sprint. We want the canary gating (item 3) in backlog for Q2 if resources allow.

raj: I'll start pulling heap profiles, KV eviction histograms, and recent config deployments. Posting preliminary graphs to the doc.

maria: Note to team: temporary reroute masks load pattern — keep the dump and avoid restarting embedder nodes unless asked.

oncall-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated by routing. Pager closed by carla.

carla: I'll create the postmortem doc and open tickets for the four action items by EOD. Assigning rough sizing in the ticket descriptions.

sam: Also add a retro note: require a 10% canary for any cache-related config change + metric alert for eviction-rate > 1k/m per node. :thumbsup:

ops-sre: Logged the infra metrics alert rule request (PR #785) and attached current graphs.

maria: Thanks everyone. Quick follow-up: preserve logs and KV dump for at least 7 days in case RCA needs longer lookback.

carla: Will do. Postmortem meeting invite sent for tomorrow 15:00 PT. Agenda: timeline, RCA, action item assignment, sizing, and quarter tie-ins.

sam: Closing note: good quick mitigation, make remediation tickets actionable with clear owners and ETA.

carla: Closing thread here — tickets will link back to this slack thread and the postmortem doc.
